chapter.sourceBody:
席玉走进客厅的时候，正看到席华年赵晓兰坐在正位，面色如常，和一旁的陈安有说有笑，气氛分外和谐。

“回来了？”赵晓兰眼中带笑，问道：“和陈家的孩子玩得怎么样？”

席玉接过蒋晨手里的公文包，朝客厅走进，站在距离三人不远不近的距离：“还可以。”说完，又朝陈安点头，叫了声陈叔。

赵晓兰笑得眯起眼来，似乎很满意席玉的回答。她挥了挥手，席玉顺势坐到侧边的单人椅上。

“我就相信你们两个孩子合得来，越长大见得次数越少，趁着现在在嘉阳，多和他接触接触，总是好的。”

席玉没说话，把公文包放在桌上，看向对面坐着的陈安。

下一秒席华年的声音就响了起来，带着岁月沉淀的稳重：“你应该也知道陈叔这次来是为什么，跟你陈叔说说，你最近搞的那个东西，到底可不可靠。”

陈安紧接着叹了口气，端起茶杯又往嘴里猛饮了一口茶水。

“我知道陈叔对这一点还是不放心，也很高兴陈叔能够真切为公司着想，今天来也是特意消除您的顾虑。”席玉站起来，俯身给陈安倒了一杯茶，双手递了过去：“您先别急，慢慢听我说。”

陈安没说话，接过茶杯，放到了桌子上。

“我们公司不论生产什么当然安全是第一位的，这是对我们每一位顾客负责。正是因为安全太重要，我们才需要转向线控。”

陈安轻皱了皱眉，嘴巴张开又合住，似是有话要说。

席华年扫了陈安一眼，陈安低头抓起茶杯又喝了一口，手撑在大腿上，直直看向席玉的脸。

“首先，电子系统中是有多层冗余备份的，这个设计能够让我们在其中一套传感器或其他处理单元失灵时，另一个都能够在20毫秒迅速接管，这些要远比我们以前的液压系统要更加可靠。其次，线控地盘系统都是要求按照行业内最高等级ASIL D级来设计的，这也就说明，它的失效概率将会降到极低。回想我们原来的传统机械系统是无法达到的。”席玉说.

陈安双眼微亮,胳膊不自觉撑在椅子扶手上,身子朝席玉这个方向靠了靠。

“同时线控底盘可以有效解决机械连接对于空间的占用问题,使得我们空间设计更加灵活智能。”

赵晓兰从始至终一直看着席玉滔滔不绝表述的样子,眼中笑意更浓。

陈安点点头,眉间皱起“川”字,“可是大小姐你应该清楚,几年前曾经有黑客攻击成功过智能汽车的案例,直接导致了车辆在路上发生事故。你说的这些确实不错,但现如今黑客这么先进,很难不保证我们的竞争对手或者其他恐怖分子雇佣黑客去入侵系统。”

“到时的后果可想而知,不论是司机还是我们的品牌,都会受到重创,甚至直接破产!这个后果谁能承担得起?!”

客厅霎时安静下来,蒋晨面色紧张,下意识看向前方的席玉。

席华年抿了一口茶水,目光落在席玉身上。

席玉垂眸,扫了一眼桌子上早已凉透的茶杯,再抬起头来,眼中无比庄重:“您说的这个我非常理解,不过我们采用的是最高级的多层次防御体系,同时我还联系了顶尖的网络安全公司,并且即将要达成合作。”

“不论是传统汽车还是智能汽车,都会面临安全问题,并不会因为我们选择传统汽车,安全就是绝对的。”席玉顿了顿,接着道:“当然,智能汽车也是如此,但是在这个阶段,既然我们想要创作出更加智能的产品,想要进步,就需要迈出更新的一步。”

“晓华能够因为我父母和您还有这些老人坚持做到现在,自然我们也要一起走下去,还要走更远。”

陈安愣了愣,眼中一瞬怔然,他盯着席玉,接着发出感慨的笑声:“大小姐你说得对,你刚刚那样子让我一瞬间想起了赵总在的时候,你的话让我心里踏实多了。”

赵晓兰也跟着笑了起来,朝陈安道:“可是很久没有听你叫我这个称呼了,真的久违了。”

陈安重重点头,立马站起身,朝席华年和赵晓兰道:“今天打扰您两位太久了,我已经知道答案了。现在我就回厂里,把大小姐的话原封不动地说给那些老家伙听!”

席华年跟着站了起来,拍了拍陈安的肩膀,脸上带了淡淡笑意:“我该多谢你为公司着想,我们不在期间,席玉可要多让你操心了。”

陈安连连摆手,笑道:“大小姐厉害着呢!大哥你谦虚了……”

席玉跟着席华年和赵晓兰送走陈安,蒋晨也跟着打了招呼,顺便离开了。

送走人后,席华年就扭头坐在了红木沙发上,脸上刚刚的笑意消失得无影无踪,无形中多了些严肃。

“你陈叔说得不无道理,那些人都是相信看得见摸得着的东西,这是一直以来亘古不变的道理。你需要再多考虑他们的意见,不能太独断了。”席华年说。

席玉点头:“是。”

席华年深深看了席玉一眼,没再说什么,起身离开。

赵晓兰拉着席玉的手坐下,笑道:“你今天表现不错,可是让我惊喜了好一阵。”

她扫了一眼席华年离开的方向,拍了拍席玉的手:“你爸其实也挺高兴的,他就是那个脾气,你也知道。”

席玉嗯了一声:“我知道。”

“不说工作了,你好不容易回来一趟。”赵晓兰笑了笑:“刚刚陈硕那孩子跟我说快回市区了,叫他过来顺便吃个饭,你们再培养培养感情,我看得出来陈硕从小就对你有意,等你忙完这一阵,顺便把婚订了,也省得我们两家操心。”

席玉薄唇抿成一条直线,轻轻抽回手来,她垂眸,敛去一闪而过的疲惫:“不用。”

赵晓兰侧脸瞧席玉,疑惑道:“怎么不用?在结婚之前肯定要互相了解相处的,你这样拒绝,怎么让事情推下去?”

“这事再说吧。”席玉站起身,伸手提起公文包,作势要走。

身后顿时响起赵晓兰的声音,语气生硬且不容拒绝:“没有再说一说,和陈家联姻是一定的,这对于你,对于我们整个公司来说都百利而无一害。我和你爸也是这么过来的,要不然哪来的这么大的公司?”

席玉眉眼轻轻蹙起,笔直地站在原地。手里的公文包被抓得攥起几处褶皱,周围一片死寂。

她原地站了半分钟,果断迈开腿往玄关走去。

“你去哪?!”身后响起赵晓兰莫名尖锐的声音,她大跨步追了出来。

席玉:“还有工作,你们吃吧。”

赵晓兰向来温和的脸上显出焦急,她叹了口气:“怎么一回来就走?!总说工作工作,实际一直是搪塞我们的借口。”

“你什么时候变得这么不喜欢呆在家里了?”

席玉回身,静静看着赵晓兰雍容华贵的面貌,她比席玉记忆里的样子皱纹要更多一些,但依然不减当年商场上叱诧风云的样子。

自从席瑶成人礼之后,她就和以前不同了。

“下周我会抽时间回来,你们早点休息。”

砰——

-

周一晚上,席瑶叫俞念一过来家里聚餐,说是介绍洛怡然和她好好认识认识,顺便有东西要给她。

席瑶和洛怡然趁着回到市区的空隙,一起去超市采购了不少东西,各类菜式肉类不少,还有很多果汁果酒。

席瑶把自己很久之前买的陈年锅拿了出来,本以为会放在仓库里吃土,却也是能派上一点用场。

“桌上有这趟度假村的季节限定糕点,我们每人一份,你记得拿上。”席瑶边配合着洛怡然洗菜边说:“我们吃过一些,口感很特别,出乎意料的好吃。”

俞念一看着桌上包装异常精美的纯白色盒子,打开看了看。

盒子上方有一张度假村绝美的明信片,内部每一个糕点都被小隔层分开,糕点造型精美,有的是雪山的图案,有的是山雪中阁的图案,还有其他很多种不同样式,看着人实在胃口大开。

俞念一问:“谁买的?”

席瑶头也没回:“陈硕。”

俞念一扯起唇笑了笑,复又将盖子盖了回去:“看来我这是沾了席玉姐的光了?”

席瑶接过洛怡然切好的菜品,顺势端到餐桌上:“你还不知道吧,昨天陈硕她们在你们走之后没多久,也跟着回去了。说是我妈叫他到家里吃饭,走的时候简直容光焕发,别提多高兴了。”

洛怡然也跟着走过来,将最后的肉品端到桌上:“确实是这样。”

席瑶吧唧吧唧嘴,叹道:“我觉得你这个挺有难度的,我姐和陈硕在长辈那可是已经同意了的,你希望渺茫。”

俞念一没接话,盯着锅里咕嘟咕嘟冒起的泡泡看。没一会,火锅的香味就飘了出来,她顾自把菜下了进去,看着它逐渐泡软。

“那不更有意思吗?”

席瑶和洛怡然皆是一愣,看向餐桌对面俞念一带着笑意的脸。

“席玉姐本人都没表态,其他人的任何想法和做法都没用,我只看席玉姐怎么回应我。”俞念一眯眼笑了笑,含笑的双眼满是狡黠:“我倒是很想和陈硕比一比。”

席瑶微微睁大眼,筷子僵在锅里半天没动,过了足有一分钟,她才缓缓说了句脏话:“你真可以。”

“其实我心里清楚,我姐压根对这些没兴趣,我爸妈非逼着她搞这些,真不知道有什么用……”她夹了一块肉放进嘴里,半开玩笑道:“如果非要我选的话,我还是认可你的。”

洛怡然也跟着点了点头,目光炯炯。

俞念一当即哈哈大笑起来,心情很好地朝两人道了谢。

这顿饭吃得很是畅快,等到三人撑得已经吃不下的时候,买回来的肉和菜品还有不少。

席瑶瘫在沙发上直打嗝儿,说着下次再吃。

吃完饭和席瑶,洛怡然收拾了家里,俞念一才准备动身往回走。

“你的糕点不拿了吗?”席瑶看向站在玄关换鞋的俞念一。

俞念一往桌上扫了一眼,挑起一贯的笑容:“不了,最近戒甜品。”

席瑶勾唇笑,看着俞念一的动作,出奇的没说话。

洛怡然跟人打了招呼,目送着俞念一走进电梯。
chapter.translatedBody:
When Xi Yu walked into the living room, she saw Xi Huannian and Zhao Xiaolan seated in the main chairs, their expressions as composed as ever as they talked and laughed with Chen An. The atmosphere was unusually harmonious.

“You’re back?” Zhao Xiaolan asked with a smile in her eyes. “How was it playing with the Chen family’s son?”

Xi Yu took the briefcase from Jiang Chen and walked into the living room. She stopped at a polite distance from the three of them. “It was all right.” Then she nodded at Chen An and called him Uncle Chen.

Zhao Xiaolan narrowed her eyes in satisfaction, clearly pleased with Xi Yu’s answer. She waved a hand, and Xi Yu took the hint to sit in the single armchair at the side.

“I knew you two children would get along. The older you get, the less often you see each other, so now that you’re in Jiayang, it’s always good to spend more time with him.”

Xi Yu said nothing. She set the briefcase on the table and looked at Chen An across from her.

A moment later, Xi Huannian’s voice rang out, steady with the weight of years behind it. “You should also know why Chen Shu came this time. Tell your Uncle Chen; this thing you’ve been working on lately, is it really reliable or not?”

Chen An let out a long sigh right after that, picked up his teacup, and took another big gulp.

“I know Uncle Chen is still uneasy about this, and I’m also very glad that you’re truly thinking about the company. I came today specifically to put your concerns to rest.” Xi Yu stood up, bent slightly, and poured Chen An a cup of tea, holding it out to him with both hands. “Please don’t rush. Listen to me first.”

Chen An said nothing. He took the teacup and set it on the table.

“Whatever our company produces, safety is naturally the top priority. That’s being responsible to every one of our customers. Because safety is so important, we need to move toward steer-by-wire.”

Chen An’s brow furrowed slightly. His mouth opened, then closed again, as if he had something to say.

Xi Huannian glanced at him. Chen An lowered his head, grabbed the teacup again, and took another sip. Supporting himself on his thigh, he stared straight at Xi Yu.

“First, electronic systems have multiple layers of redundant backups. With this design, if one set of sensors or another processing unit fails, another one can take over within 20 milliseconds. That’s far more reliable than our previous hydraulic system. Second, steer-by-wire chassis systems are all required to be designed to the industry’s highest ASIL D level, which means the failure probability is reduced to an extremely low level. That’s something our original traditional mechanical system could never achieve,” Xi Yu said.

Chen An’s eyes lit up slightly. His arms unconsciously pressed against the armrests as he leaned a little toward Xi Yu.

“At the same time, steer-by-wire chassis can effectively solve the problem of space occupied by mechanical connections, making our spatial design more flexible and intelligent.”

From beginning to end, Zhao Xiaolan had been watching Xi Yu’s unhurried explanation, the smile in her eyes deepening.

Chen An nodded, the lines between his brows creasing into a deep “川.” “But Miss, you should understand that a few years ago there was already a case where hackers successfully attacked a smart car, directly causing the vehicle to have an accident on the road. What you’re saying is indeed good, but with hackers so advanced these days, we can’t rule out the possibility that our competitors or some other terrorists might hire hackers to breach the system.”

“The consequences would be obvious. Both the driver and our brand would be hit hard; we might even go straight bankrupt! Who can possibly afford that?”

The living room fell silent at once. Jiang Chen looked tense and instinctively glanced toward Xi Yu.

Xi Huannian took a sip of tea, his gaze resting on Xi Yu.

Xi Yu lowered her eyes, glancing at the teacup on the table that had long since gone cold, then looked up again. Her expression was solemn. “I understand what you’re saying very well. However, what we’re using is the most advanced multilayered defense system, and I’ve also contacted a top-tier cybersecurity company. We’re about to reach a cooperation agreement.”

“Whether it’s a traditional car or a smart car, there will always be safety issues; choosing traditional cars does not make safety absolute.” Xi Yu paused, then continued, “Of course, the same is true for smart cars. But at this stage, if we want to create more intelligent products and make progress, we have to take a newer step.”

“Xiaohua has been able to keep going until now because of my parents, you, and all the elders who’ve insisted on it. Naturally, we have to keep walking this road together, and we have to go even farther.”

Chen An froze. A flash of bewilderment crossed his face. He stared at Xi Yu, then let out a laugh full of admiration. “Miss, you’re right. The way you were just now made me instantly think of President Zhao when she was still here. What you said really put my mind at ease.”

Zhao Xiaolan also laughed, then said to Chen An, “It’s been a long time since I heard you call me that. It really does feel familiar after all these years.”

Chen An nodded emphatically and immediately stood up, saying to Xi Huannian and Zhao Xiaolan, “I’ve already stayed here long enough and troubled you both too much today. I know the answer now. I’ll go back to the factory right away and tell those old fellows exactly what Miss said, word for word!”

Xi Huannian stood as well, patting Chen An’s shoulder with a faint smile on his face. “I should be thanking you for thinking of the company. While we’re away, Xi Yu will have to trouble you to look after her more.”

Chen An waved his hands repeatedly with a grin. “Miss is very capable! Brother, you’re being too modest... ”

Xi Yu, Xi Huannian, and Zhao Xiaolan saw Chen An out. Jiang Chen also said her goodbyes and left with them.

After seeing them off, Xi Huannian turned back and sat down on the rosewood sofa. The smile from earlier vanished without a trace, and his expression had grown noticeably stern.

“What your Uncle Chen said isn’t without reason. Those people all believe in things they can see and touch; that’s an age-old truth. You need to consider their opinions more and can’t be too arbitrary,” Xi Huannian said.

Xi Yu nodded. “Yes.”

Xi Huannian looked at her deeply for a long moment, said nothing else, and got up to leave.

Zhao Xiaolan pulled Xi Yu down to sit beside her and said with a smile, “You did well today. You really surprised me.”

She glanced in the direction Xi Huannian had gone, then patted Xi Yu’s hand. “Your dad is actually quite happy too. That’s just his temper; you know that.”

Xi Yu gave a soft mm. “I know.”

“Let’s not talk about work. You finally came back for a visit.” Zhao Xiaolan smiled. “The Chen family boy, Chen Shuo, told me he’s heading back to the city soon. Call him over and have him eat with us while you’re here; you can get to know each other more. I can tell Chen Shuo has liked you since he was little. Once you’re done being busy for this stretch, you can set the engagement while you’re at it, and it’ll save both our families a lot of worry.”

Xi Yu pressed her thin lips into a straight line and gently pulled her hand back. Lowering her eyes, she hid the flash of exhaustion that passed through them. “No need.”

Zhao Xiaolan turned to look at Xi Yu, puzzled. “Why not? Before you get married, of course you need to understand and spend time with each other. If you keep refusing like this, how is anything supposed to move forward?”

“Let’s talk about this later.” Xi Yu stood up, reached for her briefcase, and made to leave.

Zhao Xiaolan’s voice immediately sounded from behind her, stiff and impossible to refuse. “There’s nothing to talk about later. An alliance with the Chen family is a certainty. It’s beneficial in every way to you and to our entire company. Your father and I came through the same way; otherwise, where do you think such a big company came from?”

Xi Yu’s brows knit slightly as she stood rooted in place. Her fingers tightened around the briefcase, creasing it in several places. Silence fell around her.

She stood there for half a minute, then decisively lifted her foot and headed for the entryway.

“Where are you going?!” Zhao Xiaolan’s voice cut in, oddly sharp as she hurried after her.

Xi Yu said, “I still have work. You eat.”

Zhao Xiaolan’s usually gentle face showed anxiety. She sighed. “You leave as soon as you come back?! You keep saying work, work, but that’s just your excuse to brush us off.”

“When did you become so unwilling to stay at home?”

Xi Yu turned back and quietly looked at Zhao Xiaolan’s elegant, dignified face. It had more lines than the one in her memory, but it still hadn’t lost the bearing of someone who once commanded the business world.

Ever since Xi Yao’s coming-of-age ceremony, she had been different from before.

“I’ll make time to come back next week. You should both rest early.”

Bang—

-

On Monday evening, Xi Yao called Yu Nianyi over for dinner at home, saying she wanted to properly introduce Luo Yiran to her and also had something to give her.

Xi Yao and Luo Yiran had taken the chance while they were back in the city to go to the supermarket together and buy a lot of ingredients: all kinds of dishes, meat, and plenty of juice and fruit wine.

Xi Yao even brought out the old pot she had bought a long time ago. She had originally thought it would sit in storage gathering dust, but it turned out it could still be put to some use.

“There are seasonal limited-edition pastries from the resort on the table. One box each; remember to take yours,” Xi Yao said while helping Luo Yiran wash the vegetables. “We’ve already tasted some. The texture’s really special, and they’re unexpectedly delicious.”

Yu Nianyi looked at the exquisitely packaged pure-white box on the table and opened it to take a look.

On top of the box was a beautiful postcard of the resort. Inside, each pastry was separated by a small compartment. The pastries were beautifully shaped; some had snow mountain designs, some had mountain-and-snow pavilion designs, and there were many other styles too. It was impossible not to get hungry looking at them.

Yu Nianyi asked, “Who bought these?”

Without turning her head, Xi Yao said, “Chen Shuo.”

Yu Nianyi curved her lips into a smile and closed the lid again. “Looks like I’m benefiting from Xi Yu-jie’s light here?”

Xi Yao took the chopped vegetables from Luo Yiran and carried them to the dining table. “You don’t know? Yesterday, after you all left, Chen Shuo and the others also headed back not long after. My mom called him over for dinner. When he left, he was practically glowing; he couldn’t have been happier.”

Luo Yiran also came over and set the last of the meat on the table. “That is how it was.”

Xi Yao clicked her tongue and sighed. “I think yours is pretty difficult. My sister and Chen Shuo already have the elders’ approval; your chances are slim.”

Yu Nianyi didn’t answer. She just stared at the bubbles boiling in the pot. Before long, the smell of hotpot drifted up, and she casually added the vegetables, watching them slowly soften.

“Isn’t that even more interesting?”

Xi Yao and Luo Yiran both froze, looking toward the smiling face of Yu Nianyi across the table.

“Xi Yu-jie herself hasn’t said anything. Everyone else’s thoughts and actions don’t count. I only care how Xi Yu-jie responds to me.” Yu Nianyi narrowed her eyes with a smile, those laughing eyes full of mischief. “I’d actually really like to compare myself with Chen Shuo.”

Xi Yao’s eyes widened slightly; her chopsticks stayed frozen in the pot for a long moment. It took a full minute before she slowly said a curse word. “You really can.”

“Actually, I know perfectly well my sister isn’t interested in any of this at all. My parents are just forcing her into it. I really don’t know what the point is...” She夹ed a piece of meat into her mouth and said half-jokingly, “If I had to choose, I’d still be on your side.”

Luo Yiran nodded along, eyes bright.

Yu Nianyi burst out laughing at once and thanked them both in a very good mood.

The meal was eaten in great comfort. By the time the three of them were so full they couldn’t eat another bite, there was still plenty of meat and vegetables left from what they had bought.

Xi Yao lay sprawled on the sofa, hiccuping nonstop and saying they should eat together again next time.

After eating and helping Xi Yao and Luo Yiran clean up the house, Yu Nianyi finally prepared to head back.

“Aren’t you taking your pastries?” Xi Yao asked, looking at Yu Nianyi as she changed her shoes by the entryway.

Yu Nianyi glanced at the table and curved her usual smile. “No. I’m off sweets lately.”

Xi Yao smiled, watching Yu Nianyi’s movements, and for once said nothing.

Luo Yiran said goodbye to her and watched as Yu Nianyi walked into the elevator.
